# Gyro Spin Bottle

> Mobile-first 3D Spin the Bottle web application powered by WebGL 3D physics, real-time device gyroscope motion detection, Web Audio API sound synthesis, and AI Party Room prompt generation.

## Overview
- **Application Name**: Gyro Spin Bottle
- **URL**: https://gyro-spin-bottle.nullai.tech/
- **Author**: Zoth Studio Team
- **Portfolio**: https://nullai.tech/
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js (@react-three/fiber), Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API, Google GenAI SDK

## Key Capabilities
1. **3D WebGL Bottle Physics**: High-performance Three.js 3D glass bottle model with dynamic angular momentum, friction damping, and rotation physics.
2. **Device Gyroscope & Motion Sensor**: Real-time `devicemotion` and accelerometer listener allowing physical shake-to-spin functionality on mobile browsers.
3. **AI Prompt Party Room**: Interactive party game mode with player list customization, prompt categories (Truth, Dare, Deep Questions, Wild Party), and AI prompt generation with offline fallback.
4. **Web Audio API Sound Engine**: Real-time procedural audio synthesis for bottle rotation clicks, spin whirs, and victory landing chimes without external media dependencies.
5. **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)**: Keyboard navigation (`Space`, `Enter`, `S`, `M`, `P`, `R`), ARIA live regions for screen readers, high-contrast focus rings, and skip links.

## Usage Guide
- **Spinning**: Tap the "Spin Bottle" button, press `Space` / `S` on keyboard, or shake a mobile device with gyroscope enabled.
- **Audio Toggle**: Press `M` or click the speaker icon to toggle Web Audio API synthesized sound effects.
- **Party Room**: Switch to Party Mode (`P`) to add player names and receive dynamic Truth/Dare challenges for whichever player the bottle tip points to.
